description: Revoke an API key by id. The key is immediately rejected for all subsequent requests; the row is preserved (with revoked_at set) so the audit trail survives. Destructive. Requires owner role.

key_id.description: UUID of the key to revoke (the `id` field from `edgegate_list_api_keys`). This is destructive and immediate — any CI job or client still using the plaintext will fail authentication on the next request.

name: edgegate_revoke_api_key
